name: Drakon Peptides
shipsTo: Austria, Germany and the rest of the EU
legalEntity: Drakon Brands GmbH, Franzosenhausweg 45, 4030 Linz, Austria (Firmenbuch FN 687046 m)
coaAccess: Public batch archive with 36 shop-hosted PDFs and links to the laboratories. Four October Analiza Białek shop PDFs were read; the corresponding lab links returned an access challenge. An older Janoshik sample was partially cross-checked on the lab domain.
dispatchInfo: The shop says it ships from Austria via DPD, DHL and Austrian Post. The shipping policy states 1–2 working days for processing and delivery estimates of 1–2 working days for AT, 1–3 for DE and 2–6 for the rest of the EU. The homepage advertises same-day dispatch before 14:00, while the FAQ gives 3–7 working days for the rest of the EU.

subscore_reasons.labVerification: Four current shop PDFs name Drakon Peptides and match the linked product and batch archive; none could be read on the Analiza Białek domain, and the older Janoshik lookup only corroborated the analytical data, not the client or batch fields.
subscore_reasons.fillAccuracy: Four shop-hosted reports give 102.5% to 114.6% of nominal content; the BPC-157 sample is at the upper end, and no result in the scored sample was confirmed on the lab domain.
subscore_reasons.panelDepth: The four shop-hosted PDFs include HPLC, molecular mass, measured content, endotoxins, heavy metals and microbial limits tests; these are not sterility tests.
subscore_reasons.entityTransparency: The legal notice identifies Drakon Brands GmbH and gives its seat, address and registry number, which match the Austrian EVI register; the notice also publishes VAT and trade licence identifiers.
subscore_reasons.dispatchReliability: Named carriers and country-level estimates are published, but the homepage, policies and FAQ differ on processing or delivery timing; no delivery was tested.
subscore_reasons.valuePerMg: Four single-vial listings show regular and sale prices without a pack-price assumption; the small sample and time-limited sale do not establish catalog-wide value.

strengths: The Austrian EVI register confirms the named company, its Linz seat, address and registration number.
Four readable shop PDFs match the products and batch IDs in the public archive and include microbial and heavy-metal panels as well as purity and content.
weaknesses: The four sampled Analiza Białek lab links returned an access challenge; the lab-domain Janoshik extract for an older batch did not show the client or batch fields.
The shop publishes different dispatch or transit estimates across its homepage, shipping policy and FAQ; it lists SEPA bank transfer as the only payment method.
verdict: Drakon’s legal notice matches the Austrian EVI register. Its October shop PDFs link readable measurements and additional panels to four named batches, but the corresponding Analiza Białek links could not be read. An older Janoshik lookup corroborated analytical values without exposing the client or batch fields.
summary: Austrian research-reagent shop operated by Drakon Brands GmbH, with a public batch archive and EU shipping. The documented Linz company and returns address is not proof of the dispatch site; the shop gives Austria as the dispatch country.
notes: The scored COA sample is four October 2026 single-vial PDFs opened on the shop domain. The product pages link to the matching batch archive pages, and the PDFs name Drakon Peptides and the same batch IDs; no retail vial or live-stock batch was inspected. Each PDF records one customer-provided vial. Analiza Białek access returned an interstitial, not a missing-report result. Separate historical check: the Janoshik link for task 156583 returned a readable analytical page for Retatrutide 10 mg (11.06 mg and 99.421%); the client drakonpeptides.com and batch DRK-RET-MAY26 were visible only on the shop’s scanned cover sheet. That partial match is not counted in the four examples. Four standalone product prices were sampled from the public one-unit display data; no cart, order or checkout was used.
